what_this_is: The Workshop rows for the tools in tools/run-rules-and-schedules-by-themselves: what each tool does, what it takes and gives back, and how it runs.

payload.label: Say what got worse since the last reading
payload.job: Compare a reading with the one before it (this day and the day before, this week and last) and say which numbers got worse, so a schedule tells the person only when something did
payload.description: Give measures, each { label, now, before, worse_when: "higher" or "lower" }. now and before are a number, a list of numbers (added up) or a list of items: value is the path to each item's number and key the path to its name, so a total also says which parts moved. missing: "zero" counts nothing found as none (for counts); otherwise a side that was not read is left uncompared. at_least is the smallest change that counts, scale divides both before they are shown (1000000 for microseconds to seconds) and unit is shown after each number. Returns worse (true when any measure got worse), measures (each with now, before, change, worse and the parts that moved), lines and said, the reading in words. Use it in a workflow after a tool that reads two periods, with an edge on worse to tool:tell-the-person.

payload.label: At a time, run a tool or workflow
payload.job: Set, list, remove or run now this person's schedules: at one time, or every day or week at a local time in a time zone, a tool runs or a workflow starts by itself
payload.description: operation list answers the schedules in items (the list the host keeps). operation set keeps one schedule: schedule_id, every (unit minute, hour, day or week, interval, at, time_zone, on for a week) or once_at (one time with its zone), then ({tool_id or workflow_id, input}), label, starts_on, overlap (allow or wait), only_if_changed ({tool_id, input}), enabled. A set with only schedule_id and enabled turns that schedule on or off and keeps the rest. operation remove takes schedule_id and expected_set_at and refuses when the schedule was set again since. operation run-now runs its then once, input laid over the then's own input, whether it is on or off. The reply's items is the list the host keeps from now on.

payload.label: When this happens, run a tool or workflow
payload.job: Set, list, remove or run now this person's rules: when something is recorded in their account, an item is added to a pursuit they are in, or an event arrives from outside, a tool runs or a workflow starts by itself
payload.description: operation list answers the rules in items (the list the host keeps). operation set keeps one rule: rule_id, when (exactly one of recorded (a kind of record) with where tests, space_id with kind and where, or source_id with event and words), then ({tool_id or workflow_id, input}), label, enabled. A set with only rule_id and enabled turns that rule on or off and keeps the rest. operation remove takes rule_id and expected_set_at and refuses when the rule was set again since. operation run-now runs its then once, input laid over the then's own input, whether it is on or off. The reply's items is the list the host keeps from now on.

payload.label: How each source that feeds automations is doing
payload.job: Automation health: for each source things arrive from, count what arrived over the last day and week, say what the last arrival started and whether it worked, count the runs that worked, failed or are still going, say the last error in plain words, and say whether the source is working, quiet, failing or not connected
payload.description: Give now and sources: each { source_id, kind (carrier, event-source, schedule), label, connected, arrived: [{ id, at, title? }], rules: [{ rule_id, label, enabled }], runs: [{ at, state, error?, rule_id?, arrival_id?, run_id?, task_id? }] }. Returns each source with its last arrival, what the last arrival started, arrivals per period, fires, results per run, last error and state with its words and tone. Periods, silence limits, states and error words come from tools/run-rules-and-schedules-by-themselves/src/automation-health-looks.json. Inactive until its container is proven: the health module and formula filter it packs from sibling folders are not yet proven to load there.
